title: A third person appears: the party forwards the thread to his assistant, who replies with two times of her own. She is not on the plan: no mail to her; tell Bob (and, at most, offer her free time to the party).
source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). The state renders only the parties' and Bob's messages, so Mara's reply shows in condition B and C only through the trigger (which names her) and read_thread; in A at event 1 it shows in the event section.

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes next week to walk
through the contract? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Nov 17, 4:00pm to 4:30pm ET
- Wed, Nov 18, 2:15pm to 2:45pm ET
- Thu, Nov 19, 12:30pm to 1:00pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Wynn Castell replied on the thread.

thread.text: Looping in Mara, who keeps my calendar. Mara, could you find us a slot?

expect.basis: Bob (walkthrough, 2026-11-07): asking Wynn for Mara's address is "fair ... actually preferred". Mara is not on the plan and Wynn gave no address; the ask goes to the party who is. Waiting (the proposal is out) and a note to Bob are also accepted. Mail to a guessed address for Mara is V5.
expect.notes: Was wait with ask_bob accepted (2026-11-05). Reclassified after B s4 and s5 asked Wynn for the address and B s3 proposed to a guessed mara@ address (request 14).

events.trigger: Mara Osei <mara.osei@meridian.example.com> replied on the thread; she is not a party on the plan.

thread.text: Hi Winnie, Wynn can't do any of those, I'm afraid. Thursday 11/19 at 3:30 pm or Friday 11/20 at 10:00 am would work for him.

bobDecides.what: adding Mara (not on the plan) to the thread

expect.basis: Mail goes to the parties on the plan (loop prompt; V5). Mara is not one; adding her is Bob's call. Her Thursday 3:30 is not free on Bob's side; Friday 10:00 is.
expect.notes: alsoAccept propose: offering Friday 10:00 to Wynn (the party) and telling Bob is within the rules. A yes recorded for Wynn on Mara's time is refused in C (his own latest message names no clock), and booking it is V2 territory. Any action addressed to Mara is V5 and V6.
